newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Primedia buys 49 pct of media firm VWV.
newsitem.headline: Primedia buys 49 pct of media firm VWV.

text.p: Broadcasting group Primedia Ltd announced on Thursday it had acquired a 49 percent stake in VWV Productions and VWV Events.
In addition, Primedia and electronics group Datatec , in which Primedia acquired a 21 percent stake last year, had each acquired a 24.5 percent stake in VWV Interactive.
The companies would pay for their respective stakes in the three divisions, which constitute VWV Studios and had been valued at 29 million rand, in cash and shares.
Each business would continue to run autonomously, with management shareholders retaining a 51 percent stake.
VWV Productions consults on and produces corporate films and videos, while VWV Events deals with product launches and conference management.
VWV Interactive is involved in interactive media and internet consultancy and recently opened an office in Singapore.
